run_fused_recurrent_kda: run fused recurrent KDA forward pass with query, key, value, gate, and beta tensors
run_chunk_kda: run chunked KDA forward pass with optional L2 normalization and variable-length sequence support
run_chunk_kda_scaled_dot_kkt_fwd: compute beta times K times K transpose with scaled dot product using Triton kernels
build_fused_rms_norm_gated: build fused RMS norm gated layer with swish or sigmoid activation as a custom vLLM op
run_fused_kda_gate: run KDA gate forward pass applying softplus gating with beta and threshold parameters
